node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock for copper SX-EW and nickel HPAL
summary: Expanded US-listed universe for the sulphur/sulphuric-acid feedstock node. The most direct public-market exposures appear to be copper leach/SX-EW operators and nickel HPAL-linked asset owners that are acid buyers, plus a smaller discovery lane of copper ISR/leach developers whose economics may be unusually sensitive to acid availability and logistics. The key evidence input is Kpler's June 2026 report describing China's sulphuric acid export ban, sulphur route disruptions, Chilean copper SX-EW exposure, and Indonesian HPAL nickel pressure. Company-specific exposure still needs verification from filings, technical reports, and procurement disclosures.
